|colspan="7" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small><br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|tie|<small>1</small>}} <small>The vote resulted in a tie. Per Koh-Lanta rules, a revote would commence.</small><br />
{{note|ambassador|<small>2</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, Cassandre and Romain did not agree on a castaway to eliminate, therefore both of them<br />drew rocks. Cassandre lost the draw and was eliminated from the game.</small><br />
{{note|necklace|<small>3</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|blackvote|<small>4</small>}} <small>Because Karima won immunity, Romain's black vote was negated.</small><br />
{{note|pairs|<small>5</small>}} <small>Steve was Laureen's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore he was eliminated with her at Tribal Council.</small><br />
{{note|blackvote2|<small>6</small>}} <small>Because Wendy won immunity, Nicolas's black vote was negated.</small><br />
{{note|final4|<small>7</small>}} <small>At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Cécilia came in last and was eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
